data.name: Naseeba
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘n-s-b’, Naseeba means ‘destined’, ‘preordained’, or ‘fated’. In Islamic tradition, the concept of Qadar encompasses the belief that Allah (God) has predestined all things, including the lives and destinies of individuals. Naseeba, therefore, symbolizes submission to the divine plan.
